name: Nullharbor
notes: Local-space flight hitching persisted across graphics settings because the renderer still did high-cost work in performance mode: the 0.75 canvas scale floor ignored the 1.8e6 pixel budget on Fold CSS sizes, every craft extruded/gradient-lit and double-stroked the 2.16.3 silhouette, and render() filled the full buffer before the sky bake-then-fill.

Performance ships are a fill + device-locked hairline (no extrusion, per-frame gradients, or silhouette fringe). Off-screen planets, stars, and stations are culled. Scoop-zone rings and star corona stay off in performance. Balanced/high keep 2.16.3 capsule spokes and silhouette AA. Transparent synchronized #space and bake-before-fill are unchanged.
Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.16.4. Save keys stay farbound-save-v2.
